topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes students and outlines the lecture's core themes regarding cancer evolution, cell of origin, and microenvironmental influences.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how both successive genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications confer selective advantages that drive clonal expansion in pre-neoplastic tissues.

topics.label: Tissue Hierarchy and the Cell of Origin in Tumor Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal cellular hierarchy and the inherent self-renewal properties of stem versus progenitor cells influence susceptibility to oncogenic transformation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals and supportive stromal microenvironments are required to promote malignant progression in mutated cells and sustain established tumors.

topics.label: Methodological Approaches to Mapping Tumor Heterogeneity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic technologies used to resolve the spatial organization and evolutionary timing of tumor cells within their microenvironment.

topics.label: Synthesis of the Multidimensional Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how mutational burden, cellular predisposition, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental factors converge to drive cancer progression.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
